verdict.justification: The project aims to develop a mobile application for the health and well-being of remote systems engineers, graduates from the Systems Engineering program at Universidad del Valle, Sede Tuluá. The keywords 'TIC', 'aplicaciones moviles', and 'trabajo remoto' suggest that this is a mobile application. The abstract mentions an innovative mobile app designed to address health challenges associated with remote work, such as lack of physical activity, poor posture, stress, and unhealthy eating habits. The app will provide daily personalized training sessions to promote exercise and physical activity in the daily routine of systems engineers.
